data.long_meaning: A gentle and kind name, often associated with peace and serenity. The name Kairan carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kairan usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Kairan is derived from the Arabic word 'qirah' meaning gentle, kind, and peaceful.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kairan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kairan" is not a commonly used Islamic name, yet it holds a beautiful meaning and resonance within the Islamic community. In Islamic traditions and culture, a gentle and kind name is highly valued; it is believed that the angels call the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) by his loved names in the heavens (Quran 7:158). The name "Kairan" embodies these qualities and thus, it can serve as a reminder of the importance of kindness and gentleness in daily life. It also reflects the Islamic values of patience, compassion, and love, particularly emphasized during the month of Ramadan and beyond.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name "Kairan" can be seen as a representation of the gentle and compassionate aspect of Allah. Ibn al-Qayyim, a renowned Islamic scholar, wrote in his work, "Zad al Ma'ad" that Allah has 99 names, each of which reflects a particular attribute or essence. The name "Ar-Rahman" ("The Compassionate") is one of these names. Thus, the name "Kairan" can be seen as an embodiment of the divine attribute of compassion and kindness, reminding us of the mercy and love of Allah. It also echoes the oft-repeated dua (prayer) in Islam seeking Allah's mercy and forgiveness, "Rabbi al-'Afuw," meaning "Lord of Forgiveness." Therefore, the name "Kairan" carries both a cultural and spiritual significance, inspiring kindness towards others and serving as a reminder of Allah's compassion.
